sources.title: GitHub - PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR: Turn any PDF or image document into ...
sources.snippet: PaddleOCR-VL is a SOTA and resource-efficient model tailored for document parsing. Its core component is PaddleOCR-VL-.9B, a compact yet powerful vision-language model (VLM) that integrates a NaViT-style dynamic resolution visual encoder with the ERNIE-4.5-0.3B language model to enable accurate element recognition.

sources.title: PaddleOCR-VL-1.5 Introduction - PaddleOCR Documentation
sources.snippet: The model introduces text spotting (text-line localization and recognition), along with seal recognition, with all corresponding metrics setting new SOTA results in their respective tasks. PaddleOCR-VL-1.5 further strengthens its capability in specialized scenarios and multilingual recognition.
